title: Contested case on 53-lot subdivision permit
summary: The Maui Planning Commission took up a permit request for up to 53 single-family lots on about 28 acres. It set a contested case hearing for February 11, with motions and exhibit deadlines in January.

timeline.text: It set a contested case hearing (a formal, trial-like hearing) on that request for February 11.
